curriculum.label: CURRICULUM
curriculum.title: Curriculum
curriculum.materialsCaption: Core textbooks — The Gospel of the Cross, Vol. 1 & 2

subjects.title: Our Great Salvation
subjects.description: This is Book 1 of the Foundational Bible Study Series. We will explore the nature of salvation, the character of sin, and the elements of faith. By learning what it means to know God intellectually, spiritually, and morally, you will discover concretely your relationship with God and how to pray. If you attend church faithfully but feel a lack of assurance in your faith, this is a highly recommended course.

subjects.title: The Gospel of the Cross
subjects.description:
Part of the Core Bible Study Series. Made up of two volumes and 57 lectures, it covers the essence of faith step by step.

Volume 1 looks at intimate fellowship with God and a God-centered life, and at the legalism, prosperity faith, and humanism that obscure true faith. It also covers spiritual discernment and what it means to know and love God.

Volume 2 starts with distinguishing true faith from false, moves through life lived by grace, the Word, and the Spirit, and reaches the righteousness, power, and love of the Cross and the essence of faith. It brings you back to the Gospel of the Cross and into a life rooted in it.

lessons.title: The Reality of False Belief Systems
Defining What It Is to Know God
The Process of Drifting from God
Restoration to the Essence of Faith
When God's Grace Is with Us
A Life Lived by the Word
The Harmony of the Word and the Spirit
A Life Lived by the Spirit
Anointing of the Spirit and Stigma
Key Elements for a Life of Faith

subjects.title: Missional Church — The Comprehensive Nature of Redemption
subjects.description: This series examines the historical reality of the Resurrection, the Lordship of Christ, and the comprehensive nature of redemption through the biblical narrative. Through the integration of the Cultural Mandate and the Great Commission, you will learn why the church must be a missional community and understand the calling of Christians sent into the world.

subjects.title: Spiritual Leadership
subjects.description: This series trains servant leadership for the Kingdom of God. Through practical study of spiritual growth, team ministry, cross-cultural communication, and the principles of raising up the next generation, participants discover and develop their individual gifts and callings.

korea.label: EXPERIENCE KOREA
korea.title: Experience Korea Beyond the Classroom
korea.subtitle: Learning extends beyond the classroom. Throughout the program, participants will discover Korea's rich history, vibrant culture, and beautiful landscapes while building lasting friendships and unforgettable memories.

items.name: Korean Folk Village
items.desc: Step back in time and experience Korea's traditional way of life. Explore authentic homes from the Joseon Dynasty, enjoy traditional performances, and discover Korean customs, crafts, and village culture.

items.name: Seoul City Tour
items.sub: Gyeongbokgung Palace & National Museum of Korea
items.desc: Visit Gyeongbokgung Palace, the largest royal palace of the Joseon Dynasty, and explore Korea's rich history through priceless artifacts at the National Museum of Korea.

items.name: Suwon Hwaseong & Haenggung
items.desc: Explore Suwon Hwaseong Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its impressive architecture and military engineering. Visit Hwaseong and Haenggung Palace and learn about Korea's royal history and cultural heritage.

items.name: Jeonju Hanok Village
items.desc: Experience the beauty of traditional Korea by staying in one of the country's best-preserved hanok villages. Enjoy authentic Korean cuisine, traditional crafts, and the unique atmosphere of historic streets.

items.name: Everland
items.desc: Spend a fun-filled day at Korea's largest theme park, featuring thrilling rides, seasonal festivals, beautiful gardens, and opportunities to build lasting memories with fellow participants.

items.name: Jebudo Island Retreat
items.desc: Enjoy a peaceful retreat on Jebudo Island, famous for its unique tidal road that appears when the sea parts. Experience breathtaking sunsets, fellowship, reflection, and rest surrounded by nature.

instructors.label: INSTRUCTORS
instructors.title: Guiding You in Faith, Community, and Daily Life
instructors.subtitle: Throughout the program, participants will be supported by dedicated pastors, instructors, and staff who are committed to helping them grow spiritually, build meaningful relationships, and experience life in Korea. Together, our team provides biblical teaching, personal mentoring, and practical support, fostering both spiritual growth and meaningful community.

people.desc: A visionary pastor dedicated to equipping the next generation through Gospel-centered discipleship, spiritual leadership, and global missions.

people.name: Rev. Junhyung Kim
roles: Pastor, Young Adult Ministry, Vine Baptist Church
people.desc: A dedicated pastor with a passion for helping young people build a solid biblical foundation, deepen their relationship with Christ, and become faithful disciples.

instructors.guestDesc: Throughout the program, participants will learn from experienced pastors, missionaries, theologians, and Christian leaders from Korea and around the world. Guest instructors bring a wealth of ministry experience and practical insight, enriching participants through diverse perspectives and real-life ministry.
instructors.coordinatorDesc: The Program Coordinator provides day-to-day support throughout the program, assisting with orientation, accommodation, schedules, communication, and daily life to ensure a smooth, comfortable, and meaningful experience in Korea.
